## Decisions Locked
- **Master Shell Architecture:** Dual-mode shell with sticky left-hand progressive discernment rail (280px) and a centered, high-readability main stage (`max-w-6xl`).
- **Sequential Progressive Disclosure:** Enforced across 4 distinct phases (Identity → Diagnosis → Trajectory → Action & Vision).
- **Theological Color System:** Grounded earthy palette (Apostle: Deep Ochre `#9A5B2D`, Prophet: Slate Blue `#3E5C76`, Evangelist: Radiant Amber `#D97706`, Shepherd: Forest Green `#2D6A4F`, Teacher: Warm Taupe `#5C5F66`). Zero corporate red/green traffic lights.
- **Diagnostic Distinctions:** Rigorous separation of Absence (Empty Chair glyph) and Suppression (Muted Microphone glyph).
- **Integrated Drawers:** Thinking Hats Studio (Euclidean pair dialogue), Missional Copilot (theological discernment AI), and 12-page printable retreat handbook.
